lee: Quick coord: we need a docs merge plan for v3.6 rollout. Cutoff proposal: Mon May 10 18:00 UTC. Any objections?

nora: Fine with that. Two blockers: PR 1501 (versioned migration), PR 1504 (SDK snippet + changelog).

mike: Preview for 1501 shows stale anchors — likely because redirects not deployed yet. build-bot: preview 1501 failed (broken anchors).

build-bot: https://ci/preview/3500 logs: broken anchors to /docs/v3.5/...

lee: Order we should aim for: 1501 (migration) -> infra redirect -> 1504 (snippets). If redirect lags, use frontmatter `publish_date` technique to prevent early public exposure.

nora: Agree. No `skip-preview` for code or API changes. Small editorial fixes can skip with `editorial` label.

mike: I'll add JS + Go snippets to 1504 and call out method rename `client.call` -> `client.generate` in a short note.

infra-bot: Redirect PR INF-4602 opened, ETA canary Thu May 6.

lee: Great. nora please assign reviewers and post final cutover schedule in #release. I'll merge 1501 once preview passes and redirects are in staging.

nora: Done. Posting schedule now. :white_check_mark:
